text:
marie: Pushed the latest launch post draft + benchmark appendix into the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Need final copy lock by EOD Thu. Also planning webinar invite + lead routing. Quick read and flag any redlines. :wave:

ben: skimmed. Looks solid. Left a couple inline notes on the benchmark section. Quick q — do we have p50/p95 for gen and embed for the last 90 days?

sasha: I can pull those and drop a CSV into the doc by noon.

devon: @sasha please include p95, p50, and sample sizes per model variant. Marketing needs p95 to justify the "consistent latency" claim.

samira: For the webinar CTA, recommend bottom CTA be "See it in action". For gated flows we need the HubSpot form id and which list to add registrants to.

marie: CTA mapping (quick):
```
Top CTA: "Get started" -> product trial (no gate)
Middle CTA: "Request a demo" -> demo form (HubSpot form: 9823)
Bottom CTA: "See it in action" -> gated webinar form (HubSpot form: 11745) -> list: Launch_Leads_2026
Email follow-up: add to nurture sequence: nurture_launch_v1
```

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged claim on para 3: "bank-grade data isolation" — please attach SOC2/SLA link or remove phrase.

ben: hmm. let's change to "enterprise-ready" + cite SOC2 page. @legal-bot does that clear?

legal-bot: Request: attach SOC2 public report or submit compliance ticket. I can auto-clear after link is added.

jaime: For demo invites — route registrants to the HubSpot list "Launch_Leads_2026" and add property "source: launch_post". I'll create the workflow and add tags for SDR routing.

sasha: Uploaded latency CSV: https://drive.google.com/example-latency.csv — includes p50/p95 by model and by region.

marie: Nice. Copy lock checklist: (1) legal sign-off on phrasing, (2) benchmark CSV in doc, (3) webinar invite copy + HubSpot mapping. Who is final approver on copy?

devon: I'll sign off on the benchmarks once I spot-check the CSV. @sasha DM me the sampling notes.

samira: I'll own webinar invite copy. Draft is attached in the doc (section: Webinar Invite v1).

ben: If all clears, I can schedule publish for Fri 3pm PT. Need final by Thu EOD to hit that.

marie: :thumbsup: locking timeline. Action owners: marie -> chase legal, sasha -> update numbers (done), devon -> approve numbers, samira -> webinar copy, jaime -> hubspot workflow. Ping me when each complete.

legal-bot: Will re-scan in 24h and post reminder if unresolved.

marie: One more — headline options A/B in the doc, would like quick votes so design can finalize hero lock.

sasha: voted A.

devon: voted B.

ben: leaning A but tweak the subhead: replace "predictable" with "predictable, cost-efficient" (short).

marie: noted — I'll apply Ben's tweak and update the doc. Thanks team — please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done so I can close the loop.
